columns.name: DESCRIPTION OF REQUEST
columns.description:
I am respectfully writing briefly in accordance with the Freedom of Information Act to request the following public information.
1. A full copy of any/all records, documents, reports and information the (CPL) does to assist the incarcerated (in any way) with rehabilitation, reform, education, mental health, counseling/family counseling, life skills, legal books, publications, City of Chicago resources and through any programs (the (CPL) offers to assist community /citizens from Chicago . 730 ILCS 5/3-11.
2.  A full copy of any/all records, documents, reports and information the (CPL) does and or will do to assist the formerly incarcerated (in any way) with programs. Resources, involving reintegration, life skills, job training, entrepreneurship, motivational speaking, volunteering, summits/seminars, education, counseling/family counseling, low income housing community development community services and through the programs the (CPL) offers to assist community, public, citizens, and/or parolees/releases. 730 ILCS 5/3-14.
3. A full copy of any/all records, documents, reports and information the (CPL) did and/or plans to do to assist the approved reparations package that aims to benefit (police torture victim) and their families, from the (first chapter) of police torture practiced in Chicago 1972-1991, and that which was recently approved by the Hon. Chicago City Council.
A.  Also, full copy of information the (CPL) plans to do with regards  to assisting the (second chapter) of police tortured practiced in Chicago (SIC) (by police) 1992 – 2005 and before videotaping interrogations was implemented July 18/05.
